page.layout: One page of text, one column. At the top, six lines of Syriac script at full width. Below them, the Latin text in one column, with no margin notes. The catchword "indi-" stands at the lower right.

main_text.l: [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters]
Requiescere fac in regno tuo caelesti nos, & illos
post egressum nostrum de hoc mundo; & ignosce,
transfer, & remitte peccata nostra, ac Defunc-
vel deliquerimus scienter, vel ignoranter. Hinc
dimitti non solum in hoc mundo, verum etiam
in alio; Deumque exigere peccata in hoc, &
illo mundo, vel commissa sint scienter, vel
ignoranter. Et sane nisi ea exigeret, nequa-
quam pro illis Ecclesia deprecaretur; & nisi
ceret Defunctorum omni tempore, neque supplicaret
pro illis in omnibus orationibus. Deum au-
tem exigere peccata, & delicta quedam in eo
mundo, manifestum est ex Euangelio: Non exies
Beatus vero Paulus Epistola prima ad Corinth.

page.notes: The six Syriac lines at the top could not be read letter by letter, so each is marked illegible; the letter counts are estimates. The printed sentence "Requiescere fac..." is a fragment continuing from the previous page, and the page ends mid-sentence at "Corinth." with the catchword "indi-" below.
